08ecd9e257895b6f.description: Millions of people are about to start building software. Build the experience that gets their work into the world. ### The role Picture a finance analyst who has just built something brilliant with an AI agent, on their laptop, over a weekend. Today, that is where it dies. Your job is to make sure it doesn’t. You will own the experience that takes anything anyone builds, with any AI tool, and turns it into real, trusted company software, without them ever needing to become an engineer. This is developer experience for the next billion builders, and the hardest version of it: your users can’t read a stack trace, so the product has to just work. ### What you’ll own - The builder’s journey from “it works on my laptop” to “the whole company uses it”, wherever they build. - The intelligence that converts apps built anywhere into secure, connected company apps, without breaking what already works. - How Isomorph guides every builder’s own AI agent, so they get things right without learning any rules. - A product that gets smarter with every app that passes through it. ### What you’ll get to build next - Turn what we learn from every real app into an edge no general-purpose agent has. Over time, that becomes the foundation for models of our own. - Get to a world where any app goes live in minutes, and builders almost never get stuck. ### You’ll thrive here if - You have built developer tools or products that people loved, and you obsess over the first five minutes. - You are a strong engineer who can understand code you didn’t write, fast. - You live in AI coding agents and have strong opinions on how to make them reliable. - You get excited by making something hard feel effortless. ### Why Isomorph For fifty years, software inside a company has been written by a small group of engineers, for everyone else. That is ending. With AI, the people who know the work best (the finance analyst, the ops lead, the recruiter, the support manager) can now build the software they need themselves. Most of them have never written a line of code. This is one of the biggest shifts in how companies work, and it has a missing piece. The software these people build is useful, and very often unsafe: no sign-in, sensitive data exposed, nobody to run it, and invisible to IT. Multiply that across a large company and you get thousands of apps and agents that nobody governs. **Isomorph is the foundation that software runs on.** Bring an app or agent built with any AI tool, and Isomorph runs it on the company’s own cloud: secured, connected to company data and systems, monitored and kept healthy. Builders never think about infrastructure. IT stays in control of everything. We believe every company will become AI-native one workflow at a time, built by its own people. Isomorph is where that software will live. **The team.** You will join a small, high-talent-density founding team from IIT Madras and IIT Delhi. The founders are second-time founders who have built companies before and sold one. ### Why you’ll love it here - **You’ll be early.** You will be one of the first people on the team, with real ownership and a real say in what Isomorph becomes. - **You’ll work at the frontier.** AI agents and enterprise-grade infrastructure, applied to a problem every company is about to have. - **You’ll see your impact.** We work side by side with customers, so what you ship is in real people’s hands within days. - **You’ll build the way the future builds.** We build Isomorph with AI agents ourselves, so your leverage is your judgment and your taste, not your typing speed. - **You’ll grow fast.** Small team, huge surface, founders who have built and scaled before. Apply: https://isomorph.ai/careers/founding-engineer-builder-experience/

Working knowledge of SQL, including the ability to query and analyze financial data.

Experience working with financial reporting, accounting, or ERP systems.

A startup mindset: you’re energized by process improvement, AI adoption, and growth.

An ability to model EngagedMD’s core values and action principles.
• 
Superior written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to thrive in a small, fast-paced organization.
• 
Bachelor's degree or equivalent career experience.

Have experience supporting annual budgeting, financial forecasting, and budget-to-actual variance analysis.
• 
Have at least a passing familiarity with the fertility and/or healthcare industries.

Have successfully worked remotely with distributed teams in the past.
What We Offer

Competitive compensation and equity

Medical, dental, and vision coverage heavily subsidized by the company

Open Paid Time Off

Paid family and medical leave

Generous paid holidays

401(k) retirement savings plan

0837ba655603d867.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community you will join:

The communications team is responsible for telling the Airbnb story around the world. Whether we are briefing press on inspiring travel trends, highlighting unique experiences led by local hosts, or explaining how travel on our platform benefits local families and communities, we are the voice of Airbnb on a broad range of topics. We're a fast growing and high energy team with a passion for people, places and great stories.

 

The difference you will make:

Based in India, we're looking for a Senior Communications Lead, India, to own Airbnb's communications strategy in one of our most important growth markets. Reporting to the APAC Communications Director, you'll lead the India communications team and agency partners. You'll drive the work behind our consumer, policy and corporate goals, and act as a senior advisor to India leadership. You'll shape how Airbnb is seen in India, making sure local plans meet business needs while staying in line with regional and global priorities. We're looking for someone who can lead Consumer, Product, Policy and Corporate Communications under one roof, thinking holistically about strategy across all of them.

You're an experienced, strategic communicator who is at ease with senior executives, government stakeholders and top-tier media. You can handle complexity, ambiguity and pressure, and you bring sound judgment to high-stakes moments.

 

Role & Responsibilities:

  • Set and own the multi-year India communications strategy, aligned with global and regional priorities and tied to measurable business outcomes
  • Sit on the India Leadership Team as the communications voice, helping shape business priorities and drive growth in the market
  • Lead Consumer, Product, Policy and Corporate Communications as one integrated function, with a single strategy that connects all four
  • Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, Policy and Business teams in a MarComms model, so communications supports business strategy and delivers measurable business outcomes
  • Act as a trusted advisor to the India Country Manager and to visiting global executives
  • Lead, coach and grow the India communications team and agency partners, building capability and a culture of creative, high-quality work
  • Help the team prioritize against business goals, give clear direction on where to focus, and coach them on trade-offs and execution
  • Oversee editorial communications, national campaigns and the news calendar
  • Partner closely with Public Policy on regulatory and government-relations communications, and position Airbnb as a constructive voice on tourism in India
  • Lead issues and crisis management for India: prepare scenarios, guide the response, and protect reputation
  • Build executive visibility and thought-leadership platforms for local and global leaders
  • Build and maintain senior relationships with national, business and regional media across India
  • Define success metrics, report impact to regional and global leadership, and manage the market budget
  • Represent India in APAC and global communications planning, sharing local insights that shape wider strategy

 

Skills:

  • Bachelor's / Master's degree
  • Communications experience across agency and in-house, including senior roles leading teams
  • Track record of building and executing communications strategy in India for a consumer or tech brand
  • Strong network across Indian national, business and regional media
  • Deep experience in corporate, policy and/or reputation communications, including handling high-profile issues and crises
  • Experience leading or working with agencies that manage influencer and celebrity work 
  • Experience advising C-suite executives and working with government and policy stakeholders
  • Proven people leader who has built and grown high-performing teams and managed agencies
  • Sound judgment, composure under pressure, and the ability to influence across a global matrix organization
  • Excellent writing and verbal communication skills in English; Hindi or another Indian language is a plus
  • Strategic and entrepreneurial, with a strong focus on measurable results

 

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is inclusive of allowances and is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus or incentives, one or more equity programs, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.  

India Annual Pay Range
₹6,720,000—₹9,600,000 INR

 

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

About Us

Constructor.io powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you've probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We're approximately doubling year over year despite the market slow down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical.

We're a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. This role combines technical architecture design, consultative discovery, and cross-functional collaboration. You will act as a bridge between customer engineering teams and Constructor’s Product and Engineering teams.

08e7b3dabfee8c10.description:
At Duna, we see the company as the second product we're building and are continually working to create a transparent, ambitious culture. We want this to be the place where you do your best work.
Our mission is to redefine identity for the global economy. We're backed by world-class investors including CapitalG and Index Ventures, as well as founders and executives from companies like Stripe, Adyen, Notion, Remote, Qonto, Framer, Anthropic, Mollie, OpenAI and Goldman Sachs.
Duna's infrastructure is part of the product. Enterprise customers buy our reliability, security posture and auditability, not just our features.
Since your role with us will rarely fit a job description, we only wrote a crisp overview.
WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING IN THIS ROLE
• 
Own and harden our platform: AWS, Kubernetes, Postgres, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, observability and incident response
• 
Make security the default, with least privilege, secrets management and tenant isolation built into the platform instead of bolted on later
• 
Turn our SOC 2 and ISO 27001 commitments into controls and evidence that are automated, not a yearly scramble
• 
Turn recurring operational toil into self-service systems that engineers actually adopt, from preview environments to internal access
• 
Help Duna run AI agents in engineering safely, with the sandboxes, guardrails and human checkpoints that make it possible
• 
Take calm ownership of incidents, and make sure the system gets better afterwards, not just the moment
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
• 
Deep, hands-on experience with AWS (or comparable), Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability
• 
Real security engineering skills: you turn least privilege and auditability requirements into working systems
• 
Comfort with the enterprise IT side of a startup, from certifications and customer security reviews to identity and device management
• 
High agency in ambiguity, turning a vague problem into a shipped plan
• 
Pragmatic judgement about when to harden, when to simplify and when to leave something alone
• 
Curiosity about what AI changes in how we build and run software
Our platform runs on AWS and Kubernetes with Terraform, Postgres and RabbitMQ, alongside a Node.js and TypeScript product stack built on event sourcing. You will not have used all of it before. We care more about the depth you bring and how you pick up the rest.
A final note before you apply: please read through our website in detail. You'll find the fundamentals there: what we believe in, how we work, and why we're building this company.
We're a remote-first, fast-moving team of builders looking for exceptional people who love to create, build, and ship. Beyond passion and grit, we highly value curiosity, authenticity and kindness.
If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!

PS. We are looking to hire passionate people from a variety of backgrounds. So even if you don't check all the boxes, we welcome your application!

Product Manager AI

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Product Manager to lead the strategy, development, and delivery of AI-powered products. The ideal candidate will combine strong product management expertise with an understanding of AI/ML technologies, digital transformation, stakeholder management, and enterprise product delivery.

Experience

• 

8-12 years of overall product management experience.

• 

4-6 years of experience in AI/ML products or digital transformation initiatives.

• 

Experience leading AI-powered products from concept to launch and managing cross-functional teams.

• 

A proven track record of delivering enterprise-grade products with measurable business impact.

Educational Qualification

• 

B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related technical discipline is mandatory.

• 

MBA, M.Tech, or relevant certification in Product Management or Systems Engineering is preferred.

• 

An advanced degree in AI/ML, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field is an advantage.

• 

Relevant certifications in Product Management, AI/ML, Agile, or SAFe are preferred.

Key Responsibilities

• 

Define and manage the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for AI-driven solutions, including conversational AI, document processing, voice-enabled systems, and service automation.

• 

Conduct product discovery, market research, and user research to identify user needs and opportunities for AI adoption.

• 

Translate business requirements into product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria for technical teams.

• 

Manage the complete product lifecycle from ideation and development to launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.

• 

Coordinate with AI/ML engineers, Data Scientists, MLOps teams, UX designers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders to ensure successful product delivery.

• 

Define and monitor KPIs and OKRs covering user adoption, model accuracy, response time, operational cost, and customer satisfaction.

• 

Conduct competitive analysis and identify opportunities for product differentiation and innovation.

• 

Lead go-to-market planning, rollout strategies, change management, training, and user adoption initiatives.

• 

Manage product budgets, resource allocation, vendor evaluation, and contract negotiations.

• 

Promote responsible AI practices, including transparency, bias mitigation, ethical deployment, and compliance with applicable data protection requirements.

• 

Present product progress, performance metrics, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership and stakeholders.

• 

Evaluate emerging technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs), multimodal AI, and agentic AI for potential product applications.

Required Technical and Product Management Skills

AI/ML Fundamentals: Understanding of machine learning, neural networks, LLMs, NLP, computer vision, model training, inference, evaluation metrics, and the AI development lifecycle.

Product Management: Agile, Scrum, SAFe, product discovery, Design Thinking, Jobs to Be Done, roadmap planning, and backlog prioritization using MoSCoW, RICE, or Kano frameworks.

Tools and Platforms: Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Miro, Figma, Mixpanel, Amplitude, and A/B testing tools.

AI Product Lifecycle: Understanding of MLOps workflows, model deployment, performance monitoring, model drift, and production AI challenges.

Data and Analytics: Ability to work with Data Scientists on data requirements, feature engineering, training data quality, and model metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score.

Cloud and AI Technologies: Familiarity with AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, conversational AI platforms, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), voice processing, and API integrations.

Security and Compliance: Knowledge of data classification, access controls, data privacy, and responsible AI governance.

Business Analytics: Proficiency in SQL, Excel, Tableau, or Power BI for product analytics, cohort analysis, funnel optimization, and business impact measurement.

Communication and Leadership: Excellent stakeholder management, executive presentation, cross-functional coordination, and the ability to explain technical AI concepts to non-technical audiences.

Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

As Healthcare & Life Sciences Principal, Business Development (EMEA), you will partner with EMEA Sales and Sales Engineering leaders to shape and execute the region’s HLS growth strategy. You will connect market opportunity to field execution: prioritizing segments and accounts, developing repeatable vertical and horizontal plays, strengthening the organization and partner ecosystem, and leading critical customer and alliance initiatives. You will be expected to operate comfortably at three levels:

● Strategic: Define where and how Everpure should win in European healthcare and life sciences.

● Organizational: Build the capabilities, coverage, relationships, and operating cadence required to scale.

● Commercial: Personally advance priority opportunities, alliances, and executive relationships to closed business and measurable customer value.

The role requires a combination of HLS credibility, technical fluency in data and AI platforms, commercial ownership, and the ability to influence across country sales, SE, partners, and corporate teams without relying on formal authority.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own the Pipeline & Financial Performance: Own the booking targets and financial performance for the segment by developing and executing a multi year strategic growth plan. Drive and scale the overarching pipeline and bookings targets across the EMEA ecosystem, establishing clear qualification criteria and pipeline visibility.  

Define the EMEA Value Proposition: Define and articulate the value proposition for Healthcare & Life Sciences to drive growth and establish Everpure as the industry leader.  

Architect & Execute Joint GTM Plans: Author and launch strategic go-to-market plans with priority partners, aligning internal cross-functional EMEA teams (Partner Account Teams, Core Sales, Alliances, Marketing) to unlock high-potential HLS customer accounts and activate new revenue streams.

Orchestrate Strategic Alliances: Orchestrate strategic vertical alliances and operationalize relationships with key partners to secure reference architectures and joint go to market motions.  

Enable and Mobilize the Partner Ecosystem: Equip sales teams and partners with the specialized tools, training, and playbooks they need to successfully position and sell vertical solutions. Train and align Partner representatives ensuring they can effectively articulate our value proposition, economic differentiation, and technical sizing for healthcare compliance.  

Drive Joint Demand Gen & Thought Leadership: Act as a spokesperson for your vertical vision in customer meetings, industry events, analyst briefings, and media opportunities. Build credibility as a principal advisor by shaping the industry narrative around intelligent data foundations and enterprise AI adoption.

WHAT YOU BRING

HLS & Alliance Expertise: Proven success leading strategic business development or alliance management within the technology sector, with a deep understanding of customers solutions, cloud economics, and the specific regulatory, data, and compliance needs of the EMEA Healthcare and Life Sciences sector.

Cross-Functional Influence & Execution: Develop and execute the global strategy for your segment in partnership with Product Management, Sales, and Engineering teams. A track record of balancing high-level strategy with a "roll-up-your-sleeves" execution mindset, showing a strong ability to build trust and influence executive leaders across partner organizations.

Agile Collaboration & Communication: Outstanding business acumen and communication skills, with a collaborative approach to thriving in a fast-paced, cross-functional, and multi-cultural EMEA environment.

Location & Travel: We operate in a hybrid/field-based model. You will be expected to work effectively from a regional corporate office in a key EMEA market, with the ability to travel 25–40% across the region as business needs require.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:

  • Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
  • Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
  • Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.

We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.
